mapper.sql: SELECT c.carton_id, c.request_id, c.carton_code, c.requested_code, c.outbound_id, o.reference_id AS fba_shipment_id, p.status, c.operator_id, c.created_at FROM wms_fba_carton c JOIN wms_outbound_package p ON p.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND p.package_id = c.carton_id JOIN wms_outbound_order o ON o.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND o.order_id = c.outbound_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wms_fba_carton(tenant_id, carton_id, request_id, carton_code, requested_code, outbound_id, operator_id, created_at) VALUES (#{tenant}, #{c.cartonId}, #{c.requestId}, #{c.cartonCode}, #{c.requestedCode}, #{c.outboundId}, #{c.operatorId}, #{c.createdAt}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
